feeds.title: Asante Africa Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The educational nonprofit blog features relevant topics and highlights stories of key youth, educators, and staff from the field. In addition to participants' stories, they also accept blog submissions that align with their mission. The foundation's goal is to educate and empower the next generation of change agents, whose dreams and actions transform the future for africa and the world.

feeds.title: World Education Blog » Africa
feeds.description: This blog is curated by the Global Education Monitoring Report (GEM Report) which is editorially independent of UNESCO. As a platform for guest blogs from actors across the sector, the opinions expressed are those of the authors. Guest-authored blogs do not purport to reflect the opinions or views of the GEM Report or UNESCO. The blog has a separate section for all the information, news and updates related to the African education sector.

feeds.title: Distance Education for Africa Blog
feeds.description: DeAfrica is a non-profit educational organization, registered as a charity in Washington DC with operational offices in Nairobi, Kenya. We are committed to drastically increasing equitable access to high-quality, demand-driven, flexible, cost-effective, and affordable education and training by skilling, upskilling and reskilling communities in Africa to create lasting gender equity and economic impact through education. Follow the education blog to read about topics such as education, students, teaching, government, graduation ceremonies, awards and more.

feeds.title: Education Ghana
feeds.description: EducationGhana.org is an online Education Resource and News Blog which serves its readers with authentic information regarding Education in Ghana.

feeds.title: Texila American University Zambia Blog
feeds.description: The TAU blog brings you the latest information in educational sector degree offerings, career advice, and tips to help you achieve success. TAU Zambia is a recognized & approved institute by the Ministry of Higher Education Zambia(HEA) to offer Bachelors, Masters, and PhD Programs in various streams.

feeds.title: Africa Education Partnership
feeds.description: AEP is dedicated to helping by partnering in a practical manner. They understand the importance of working with local businesses, and religious, and education leaders of the community to facilitate the construction and funding of schools. The Africa Education Partnership blog covers topics like education, students, government, organization news and more.

feeds.title: Nurturing Minds Blog
feeds.description: Nurturing Minds and the SEGA Girls' Secondary School started in 2007 as the dream of two colleagues, one American, Polly Dolan, and one Tanzanian, Blastus Mwizarubi. They wanted to provide an opportunity for marginalized Tanzanian girls to escape poverty and exploitation, and receive a quality education; to empower girls with the skills and credentials needed to thrive in Tanzanian society. Follow the Nurturing Minds Blog features personal stories, programs, events, activities, education information and more.

feeds.title: Education Matters Africa Blog
feeds.description: Education Matters matches talent with opportunity. Youth hold the keys to the future, and we are here to help motivated students realize their dreams. They believe that there are many determined and talented students who lack only financial resources and information to better their educational futures. Follow the blog to learn about their programs, annual reports, awards, students spotlight, and more.

feeds.title: Teach With Africa Blog
feeds.description: Teach With Africa is a non-profit organization empowering students and teachers in a reciprocal exchange of teaching and learning in Africa and the United States. Teach With Africa seeks to reduce the embedded inequities in our societies by working to provide access to quality education in order to transform children's lives, schools, and communities. The teach With Africa Blog covers topics such as gratitude, summits, education, podcast, and more.

feeds.title: Education International Africa Blog
feeds.description: Education International Africa Region is made up of 124 Affiliates in 53 of the 55 countries in Africa, including Lebanon and Palestine in the Middle East. Several countries have multiple education sector unions making unity among and within unions a major concern for the region. The regional office is preoccupied with helping affiliates to develop stronger unions and encouraging them to form united fronts. They have an education blog featuring information on all of thier activities, campaigns, students and more.

feeds.title: Creating and Deploying Digital Educational Resources.
feeds.description: I like to share digital skills with educators. Educators should be able to help themselves create great education resources using only the tools already on their workstations and free tools from the internet.

feeds.title: Nic Spaull
feeds.description: My name is Nic Spaull and I'm an Associate Professor in the Economics Department at Stellenbosch University and advisor to the Allan & Gill Gray Foundation. Founder of Funda Wande. Full CV here. So this is my blog, which is a selective collection of thoughts about my reality and anything else I think is interesting or noteworthy. This blog also covers all the necessary information and updates about the education system in Africa.

feeds.title: Education Africa
feeds.description: Education Africa is a non-profit organization with a proud track record of successful delivery of its thriving projects. Their Education Africa blog is about news, updates, stories, programs, events, and more.
